title: Optimization of Laser Ablation Resistance for Multilayer Heterogeneous Thin Films Based on Optical–Thermal–Ablation Coupling and a BP Neural Network Surrogate Model
title_zh: 基于光热烧蚀耦合和BP神经网络代理模型的多层异质薄膜激光烧蚀抗性优化
summary: 多层异质薄膜在连续波激光加热下的热物理响应涉及由干涉引起的驻波吸收调制的不均匀体积发热，它控制着逐层相变序列和最终的热失效阈值——传统比尔-朗伯近似无法捕获的耦合。这项研究开发了一种光热烧蚀耦合模型，该模型可以解析驻波吸收曲线，并将其与具有潜热效应的温度相关瞬态热传导耦合，并在七个功率级别的激光损伤实验中进行了验证。构建了一个基于两阶段替代的框架来探索热物理设计空间，其中离散材料选择和连续层厚度共同控制吸收分布和熔化顺序。
abstract: The thermophysical response of multilayer heterogeneous thin films under continuous-wave laser heating involves non-uniform volumetric heat generation modulated by interference-induced standing-wave absorption, which governs the layer-by-layer phase-change sequence and the ultimate thermal failure threshold—a coupling that conventional Beer–Lambert approximations fail to capture. This study develops an optical–thermal–ablation coupled model that resolves the standing-wave absorption profile and couples it to temperature-dependent transient heat conduction with latent-heat effects, validated against laser-damage experiments at seven power levels. A two-stage surrogate-based framework is constructed to explore the thermophysical design space in which discrete material choices and continuous layer thicknesses jointly control the absorption distribution and melting sequence. The optimal architecture is identified as SUS304/Ag/Si₃N₄/SiO₂/ITO with a refined thickness profile of 21 µm/0.106 µm/0.18 µm/2.35 µm/0.05 µm under a 25 µm total constraint, yielding a 209.6 K reduction in peak temperature relative to the baseline. The analysis reveals three thermophysical mechanisms: (i) in the interference layer, the order-of-magnitude reduction in volumetric optical absorption dominates over the 2.5-fold difference in thermal conductivity in determining the peak temperature; (ii) the positive temperature coefficient of thermal conductivity in the SUS304 substrate provides a self-regulating thermal-sink effect; and (iii) the Ag layer exhibits a non-monotonic thermal response beyond its optical saturation thickness, governed by the competition between cross-plane thermal resistance and in-plane thermal spreading coupled with absorption-peak shifting. These results clarify how interference-modulated heat generation governs phase-change sequences and thermal failure in multilayer thin films.

title: Toward chemically accurate quantum simulations on quantum hardware: A quantum-HPC hybrid approach
title_zh: 在量子硬件上实现化学精确的量子模拟：量子 HPC 混合方法
summary: 我们报告了迄今为止最全面的基于量子计算的分子模拟实验演示之一，该实验演示在 IQM 的 Sirius 24 量子位超导量子处理器上进行，使用多达 16 个操作量子位。我们采用基于样本的量子对角化 (SQD) 和局域酉簇 Jastrow (LUCJ) Ansatz 来计算基准分子系统的基态能量，包括 H 2 、LiH、BeH 2 、H 2 O 和 NH 3 。
abstract: We report one of the most comprehensive experimental demonstrations to date of quantum-computing-based molecular simulation on IQM’s Sirius 24-qubit superconducting quantum processor, using up to 16 operational qubits. We employ Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) with the Local Unitary Cluster Jastrow (LUCJ) Ansatz to compute ground-state energies of benchmark molecular systems, including H 2 , LiH, BeH 2 , H 2 O, and NH 3 . We further introduce the linear-CNOT unitary coupled-cluster singles and doubles Ansatz within the SQD framework, reducing the classical pre-computation overhead at the cost of increased quantum circuit depth and demonstrate its effectiveness by accurately recovering the ground-state energies of H 2 , LiH, and BeH 2 . A comparative analysis of the two Ansätze is presented, highlighting their respective merits, demerits, and practical use cases in near-term quantum simulations. In addition, we perform one-dimensional potential energy surface (1D-PES) scans for H 2 and HeH + using STO-3G and 6-31G basis sets and for LiH and BeH 2 using STO-3G. We also report the first experimental generation of a full two-dimensional potential energy surface (2D-PES) map, consisting of a 32 × 32 grid in bond length and bond angle, for the water molecule in the STO-3G basis on IQM quantum hardware. Beyond small-molecule benchmarks, we integrate Density Matrix Embedding Theory (DMET) with SQD(LUCJ) to obtain chemically accurate 4-electron-in-4-orbital active-space energies for eight ligand-like molecules, as well as for the pharmacologically relevant amantadine molecular system, representing the first of such experimental demonstrations. Across all studies, the majority of quantum-computed energies agree with reference full configuration interaction results and with DMET-complete active space CI energies for embedded systems, to within chemical accuracy for the chosen basis sets. These results demonstrate the robustness of quantum sampling-based classical diagonalization approaches while highlighting the promise of hybrid embedding strategies combined with near-term Ansätze for advancing quantum chemistry toward classically intractable molecular systems and establishing their practicality on current quantum hardware.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: QEpy: Quantum ESPRESSO in python
title_zh: QEpy：Python 中的量子浓缩咖啡
summary: QEpy 是一个基于 Quantum ESPRESSO (QE) 的 Python 电子结构软件包。 QEpy 实现了两个目标。首先，它简化了 QE 的运行和原型计算。其次，它针对非标准工作流程，其中电子结构引擎的使用方式与最初设计的方式不同。例如，QEpy 可以指示 QE 使用哈密顿量中的自定义势来运行，包括外部势、交换相关势和局部赝势。 QEpy 还可以在电子结构计算期间的任何时刻（包括自洽场循环之间）公开通常只能通过后处理才能访问的量，例如电子密度和波函数。
abstract: QEpy is a Python electronic-structure software package based on Quantum ESPRESSO (QE). QEpy accomplishes two goals. First, it simplifies running and prototyping calculations with QE. Second, it targets nonstandard workflows where the electronic-structure engine is used in ways for which it was not originally designed. For example, QEpy can instruct QE to run with custom potentials in the Hamiltonian, including external, exchange-correlation, and local pseudopotentials. QEpy also exposes, at any point during an electronic-structure calculation, including between self-consistent-field cycles, quantities that would normally be accessible only through post-processing, such as the electron density and wavefunctions. QEpy’s API to the Atomic Simulation Environment gives direct access to ASE-based workflows and tools. These capabilities make QEpy a flexible platform for implementing custom workflows, interfacing QE with other simulation tools, and prototyping new electronic-structure methods. This work is written in a hybrid paper/tutorial style. Several example notebooks are presented, together with references to publications in which QEpy has already been employed. Our goal is for QEpy to serve as a versatile platform for research, teaching, and innovation in electronic-structure theory and method development.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Substantial Reduction of Hole Injection Barrier at the Au/Rubrene Organic Semiconductor Interface Using PFBT Self-Assembled Monolayers
title_zh: 使用 PFBT 自组装单分子层大幅降低 Au/Rubrene 有机半导体界面处的空穴注入势垒
summary: 使用自组装单层（SAM）进行表面功能化是优化有机电子器件中电荷注入和界面能量的有效且广泛采用的策略。特别是，2,3,4,5,6-五氟苯硫酚 (PFBT) SAM 被广泛用于增强贵金属电极（例如 Au）的功函数，并有利地模板有机半导体分子堆积。然而，详细描述 PFBT 改性金/有机半导体界面上与厚度相关的能级排列的全面原位光谱研究仍然很少。
abstract: Surface functionalization using self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) is an effective and widely adopted strategy for optimizing the charge injection and interfacial energetics in organic electronic devices. In particular, 2,3,4,5,6-pentafluorothiophenol (PFBT) SAMs are widely employed to augment the work function of noble metal electrodes, such as Au, and favorably template organic semiconductor molecular packing. However, comprehensive in situ spectroscopic investigations detailing the thickness-dependent energy-level alignment across the PFBT-modified Au/organic semiconductor interface remain scarce. This study investigates the interfacial electronic structures of 5,6,11,12-tetraphenylnaphthacene (rubrene) deposited on air-exposed Au (Air-Au), ultraviolet-ozone-treated Au (UVO-Au), and UVO-Au-functionalized PFBT (UVO-Au/PFBT) using in situ X-ray and ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS and UPS). High-resolution XPS reveals that UV–O3 pre-activation forms an ultrathin gold oxide (AuOx) layer, thereby dramatically enhancing the chemisorption kinetics and packing density of the PFBT SAM. While UV–O3 treatment alone increases the work function of Au from 4.78 to 5.06 eV, subsequent PFBT chemisorption further elevates it to 5.33 eV via a pronounced permanent dipole moment directed toward the substrate. Consequently, the hole injection barrier at the Au/rubrene interface is progressively reduced from 0.65 eV for Air-Au to 0.40 eV for UVO-Au and ultimately down to 0.27 eV for UVO-Au/PFBT. This dramatic reduction reaches the thermodynamic Fermi-level pinning regime, providing direct spectroscopic evidence for establishing near-Ohmic contacts. These findings offer fundamental insights into contact-resistance minimization and interface design for high-performance organic optoelectronic devices.
